One competition platform

Everything your match needs.

Designed around the actual workflow of clubs, Match Directors, Range Officers, scorekeepers, and competitors.

🏆

Match Management

Create club shoots, cups, tournaments, and championships with configurable disciplines, divisions, categories, squads, and schedules.

◉

Shooter Registration

Manage competitors, memberships, divisions, categories, squads, check-in, and match assignments in one place.

◎

Stage Builder

Configure targets, required hits, rounds, scoring method, briefings, classifiers, and stage-specific rules.

ϟ

Real-Time Scoring

Fast touch-friendly score entry with immediate calculation, verification, and audit-ready records.

▥

Live Results

Automatically calculate stage results, match totals, division rankings, category rankings, and live standings.

▤

Reports & Analytics

Generate scorecards, stage reports, match results, certificates, exports, and historical shooter performance.
